title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Claims Service Standards
content:
The claims standards of the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** are the same for all six tiers (Residential Mandatory Amount, Residential Gap, Residential Replacement Cost, Manufactured Home, Commercial Building, Commercial Building and Contents).

| Standard | Meaning | Value on every tier |
|---|---|---|
| Payee | Payee of certificate claim payments | The lender and the borrower jointly |
| Proof of loss | Days after the date of loss within which the proof of loss must be received | 60 calendar days |
| Payment | Days after the agreed proof of loss within which Tidemark pays | 30 calendar days |
| Adjuster contact | Tidemark standard for the adjuster's first contact | 48 elapsed hours |

## Reading the standards
- The 60-day proof-of-loss period is counted from the date of loss; the 30-day payment period is counted from the agreed proof of loss.
- The 48-hour standard is measured in elapsed hours, not calendar days.
